02 / EXPLICIT BY DESIGN

Why explicit control matters.

Automated pipelines often hide consequential chemical assumptions behind a single button. Ankora automates the mechanical plumbing while keeping every scientific decision auditable.

01

Immutable originals & stale propagation

BLACK-BOX RISK

Overwriting imported PDB/SDF files in place or keeping downstream poses after upstream edits.

ANKORA CONTRACT

Every import and derivative is SHA-256-locked; changing an upstream receptor, ligand state or box marks dependent results stale.

02

Selective chemistry, never silent guessing

BLACK-BOX RISK

Blind loop reconstruction, silent side-chain fabrication or arbitrary stereoisomer selection.

ANKORA CONTRACT

Per-residue repair or exclusion, PROPKA pKa review, explicit Dimorphite-DL protonation candidates and required stereocenter choices.

03

Separate scoring families & honest GPU claims

BLACK-BOX RISK

Pooling kcal/mol and CNN probabilities into unvalidated consensus scores or silently falling back to CPU.

ANKORA CONTRACT

Vina, AutoDock4/GPU and GNINA keep native units; matched CPU campaigns report Spearman rank agreement without merging scores.

04

In-place RMSD with sampling vs ranking split

BLACK-BOX RISK

Superposing predicted poses onto crystallographic ligands, erasing translation and pocket-placement errors.

ANKORA CONTRACT

Computes symmetry-aware heavy-atom RMSD in the crystal frame and reports geometric recovery separately from top-1 score ranking.

05

Record-derived Methods & retained failures

BLACK-BOX RISK

Dropping failed molecules from screening tables or emitting generic boilerplate methods prose.

ANKORA CONTRACT

Retains unscored and failed entries in the campaign census and derives Methods from verified records with explicit gaps when data is absent.

03 / VIRTUAL SCREENING

One compound.
Or a whole library.

Clean and prepare a library before spending time on docking. Keep the selection, each chemical state and every failed molecule in the record.

01

Filter before you minimize

Lipinski, Veber, Ghose, Muegge and QED. PAINS/Brenk alerts, duplicate detection and custom descriptor rules inform an explicit selection.

02

Prepare an independent conformer

Inspect mass, SMILES, charge and stereochemistry. Generate ETKDGv3 coordinates, minimize with MMFF and write PDBQT with Meeko.

03

Process in parallel, within a budget

Bounded multicore preparation and molecule-level docking progress. Failures remain visible instead of disappearing from the campaign.

CURRENT DISTRIBUTION / PRIVATE BETA & LINUX RC

Built for real work.
Being tested with care.

Ankora is currently shared with invited testers on Windows 11 x64 (private beta) and Linux x86_64 (release candidate on branch codex/linux-bootstrap, pending bare-metal workstation Gate D6); there is no public installer release yet.

Ask about the beta

The beta is unsigned. Follow your institution's software policy; do not disable system security. GPU drivers remain the hardware vendor's responsibility.

Do I need to install Python, Java or CUDA toolkits?

Not for the offline bundles. The Windows 11 beta installer and Linux x86_64 release-candidate packages (.deb and user-space .tar.zst) include a private Python runtime, Java 21, preparation tools, Vina, AutoDock4, AutoDock-GPU and P2Rank. On Linux, GNINA 1.3.3 and its 17 user-space CUDA 12.8 / cuDNN 9 libraries import in one click from an offline companion archive without sudo; only the host NVIDIA kernel driver is required for GPU runs.

Does my research leave my computer?

Preparation and docking run locally. Ankora has no telemetry or automatic cloud upload. Retrieving a structure from RCSB or AlphaFold is an explicit network action. Separately, this website uses a third-party visitor counter, explained in the footer; it receives no scientific data from the application.

What is the status of Windows 11, Linux and macOS?

Windows 11 x64 is the authoritative private-beta platform. Linux x86_64 is a feature-complete release candidate on branch codex/linux-bootstrap (PR #1), verified clean-room in WSL2/WSLg with real RTX 5050 CUDA runs, and awaits bare-metal non-WSL Linux workstation attestation (Gate D6) before full official release status is claimed. macOS is not supported.

What does open source mean here?

Ankora's code is available under the MIT license. Bundled third-party components retain their own licenses, notices and corresponding-source obligations. Cite the software and tools you use in published research.

About visitor privacy

Loading this image sends your IP address and browser information to Flag Counter (Boardhost), which estimates a country without GPS. According to its policy, the free counter uses no cookies, does not log raw IP addresses and publishes aggregate totals; it uses a temporary IP-derived hash for deduplication. This measures website visits only, not desktop research data.

VPNs, shared networks, blockers and caching can affect these approximate counts. The provider's statistics pages may contain advertising and cookies.
